items.q: What is a Real Estate Web Portal?
items.a: A Real Estate Web Portal is an online platform where users can search, compare, and inquire about residential or commercial properties. It helps real estate businesses manage listings, customer inquiries, bookings, and lead generation efficiently.

items.q: Which features can be included in a real estate portal?
items.a: A custom Real Estate Web Portal can include property listings, advanced search filters, Google Maps integration, real estate CRM software, online booking systems, payment gateways, virtual tours, and customer dashboards.

items.q: How long does it take to develop a Real Estate Portal in Indore?
items.a: A basic Property Listing Website Development project may take 4 to 6 weeks, while advanced Real Estate Portal Development with CRM and booking systems may require 8 to 12 weeks.

items.q: Do you provide Real Estate Mobile App Development?
items.a: Yes, we provide Real Estate Mobile App Development for Android and iOS platforms integrated with property listings, inquiry forms, booking features, and customer management systems.
